card.name: The title CEO in bios
card.fires_on: The word CEO, mostly right after president and or a name, when a person is introduced with their company role. Also fires on CEO as a company title in news text.

modes.label: Person introduced as CEO
modes.description: CEO follows 'president and' or 'is' in a short bio or quote attribution, before 'of' and an organization.
modes.example: Jennifer Helgeson, president and<< CEO>> of Boys and Girls Clubs of Kentuck

modes.label: CEO as a general title
modes.description: CEO used as a modifier or topic in news text, such as pay or former company leaders.
modes.example: Led by former Halliburton<< CEO>> Vice President Dick Cheney, the framers
